blind.description: A classical garden stone urn atop an integral pedestal pillar. It consists of a circular moulded base, a short round column shaft with a torus moulding at the top, supporting a decorative lidded urn adorned with sculpted draped swags, medallions, and a pointed bud-shaped finial on top of the lid. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with no holes, broken shards, or floating elements. Sits firmly and flat on the ground on its own base. The material appears to be weathered cream or light beige carved limestone/marble with aged greenish moss or lichen stains along the recesses and crevices.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it appears as a concentric set of circular rings showing the outer rim of the urn, the lid, and the central finial at the very center, casting a distinctive urn-and-pedestal silhouette shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.2 feet (around 1.0 meter) tall, reaching roughly halfway up the 5 ft 9 in figure's torso, and about 1 foot in diameter at its widest points.
